name: GoogleMaps
description: Enrich a DataFrame with Google Maps route geometry, distance, and travel-time data (calls the navigator Google Maps Route API per row).
usage: Operates on rows that contain an ``origin`` and a ``locations`` list (each location with latitude/longitude/location_name/store_id). Locations are sorted by ``timestamp_key`` and a waypoint route (plus an optimal route) is computed, adding route/distance/duration columns (and ``opt_*`` variants).

attributes.name: zoom
attributes.description: Map zoom level for any embedded map output. Default ``10``.

attributes.name: map_scale
attributes.description: Scale factor for map output (1 or 2). Default ``2``.

attributes.name: timestamp_key
attributes.description: Column inside each ``locations`` entry used to sort stops by departure time. Default ``timestamp``.

attributes.name: departure_time
attributes.description: Fixed departure time (ISO string) used when a row has no per-row ``departure_time``. Default ``None``.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Route method (navigator ``Route``) to dispatch: ``get_route`` (origin→destination route) or ``waypoint_route`` (multi-stop route). An optimal-route pass is also computed and added as ``opt_*`` columns.
